title: Hotel Check-In: Room Key and Amenities
description: Giao tiếp khi nhận phòng khách sạn: hỏi mật khẩu wifi, giờ ăn sáng và tiện ích.

coreVocabulary.contextSentence: I have a confirmed hotel reservation under the name Wilson.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: tiện nghi, tiện ích khách sạn
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: The hotel amenity list includes a rooftop pool and fitness center.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: miễn phí (do khách sạn phục vụ)
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Breakfast is complimentary and served every morning on the terrace.

transcript.en: Hello travelers, Emma here guiding you through a smooth hotel reception check-in.
transcript.vi: Xin chào các du khách, Emma ở đây hướng dẫn bạn làm thủ tục nhận phòng khách sạn suôn sẻ.

transcript.en: Always double-check luggage dimensions and weight allowances before arriving at the departure station.

transcript.en: Familiarizing yourself with key transit announcements helps you navigate unfamiliar terminals smoothly.

transcript.en: Polite inquiries with station staff will save you valuable time when finding your departure gate.

transcript.en: After a long transatlantic flight, stepping into your hotel lobby is such relief.

transcript.en: Asking for confirmation ensures you board the correct connection without confusion.
